mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.job_id AS jobId, j.job_name AS jobName, j.company_name AS companyName, m.overall_score AS overallScore, m.key_skill_match_rate AS keySkillMatchRate, m.summary, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM job_student_matches m INNER JOIN jobs j ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC
